title: Fix stale cache auto-refetch in useChapterMetaList
description: Add useEffect that watches snapshot.stale and triggers loadProjectChapterMeta when stale becomes true. This ensures the writing page auto-refetches chapter data when invalidateProjectChapters is called from the outline page.

files.change: Add useEffect after L46 that watches snapshot.stale and calls chapterStore.loadProjectChapterMeta(projectId) when stale is true

criteria: When outline creates chapters and calls invalidateProjectChapters, the writing page automatically refetches chapter list without manual refresh
No infinite loop: stale is reset to false after successful refetch (already handled by replaceProjectMeta at chapterStore.ts:154)
